<<A WORD ABOUT STACKING PEAT FOR A STOVE>>

PEAT IS A NATURAL AND CLEAN-BURNING FUEL THAT CAN BE STACKED FOR A STOVE. IT IS EASY TO STORE AND HEATS EFFICIENTLY. MAKE SURE TO STACK IT PROPERLY TO PREVENT FALLING AND TO KEEP IT SAFE. USE A LEVEL SURFACE AND STABLE BASE. THIS HELPS TO MAXIMIZE HEAT AND MINIMIZE DUST. PLEASE FOLLOW SAFETY PRECAUTIONS WHEN USING PEAT IN A STOVE.
